name: Architecture Firms
boundary: Not `engineering-consultants`: covers licensed architects who own design intent, code compliance and construction administration for buildings, not the engineers who stamp structural or MEP calculations under them; not `general-contractors`, who build what architects draw.

name: Landscape Architecture Firms
boundary: Not `landscaping`: covers licensed landscape architects who design grading, stormwater, hardscape and planting plans and administer bids; landscapers install and maintain. Not `architecture-firms`: separate licence (LARE) and site-civil scope.

name: Interior Design Firms
boundary: Not `architecture-firms`: interior designers specify finishes and FF&E and earn on product markup as well as fees, and most states do not let them stamp drawings; not `product-design-studios`, which design digital products and interfaces.

name: Graphic Design Studios
boundary: Not `marketing-agencies-smb`: covers studios and freelancers paid per design deliverable (identity, packaging, publication layout) with no media buying or campaign strategy; not `product-design-studios` (digital product and UX design) or `ux-research-agencies`.

name: Specialty Design Studios
boundary: Not `graphic-design-studios` or `product-design-studios` (digital product design): covers fashion, textile, exhibit and set designers whose deliverable is a tech pack or fabrication drawing handed to a factory or fabricator, iterated through sampling rounds.

name: Drafting Services
boundary: Not `architecture-firms` or `engineering-consultants`: covers unlicensed CAD and BIM drafting bureaus, many offshore, that turn others' markups into drawing sets and shop drawings at per-sheet or hourly rates with no design liability.

name: Testing Laboratories
boundary: Not `environmental-consultants` or `home-inspection`: covers ISO 17025-accredited labs that test materials, products and samples (construction materials, EMC, product safety, food and environmental analytes) against standards and issue certificates; human specimens belong to `clinical-laboratories`.

name: Geophysical Survey Firms
boundary: Not `land-surveyors`: covers firms that acquire and interpret seismic, magnetic, gravity, GPR and electromagnetic data about the subsurface for energy, mining, utility and engineering clients; land surveyors fix boundaries on the surface. Not `oil-gas-field-services`.

name: Logistics Consultants
boundary: Not `compliance-consulting` or `revops-consultancies`: covers consultants who design distribution networks, warehouse layouts, transport procurement and inventory policy for shippers; `warehouse-3pl` and `freight-brokerage` run the operations they design.

name: Contract Research Labs
boundary: Not `engineering-consultants`: covers organisations whose product is research itself (Battelle- and SRI-style labs, SBIR shops, university spinouts) funded by contracts and grants; drug discovery belongs to `biotech-research-firms`.

name: Biotech Research Firms
boundary: Not `contract-research-labs` or `medical-device-mfg`: covers drug-discovery biotechs and preclinical CROs whose wet-lab work runs under FDA GLP rules and is funded by venture rounds and pharma partnerships, before anything reaches a manufacturing plant.

name: Public Relations Agencies
boundary: Not `marketing-agencies-smb` or `influencer-marketing-platforms`: covers PR firms paid on retainer to earn coverage, run media relations and manage crises, judged on placements and message pull-through rather than paid media; 541820 also includes public affairs, lobbying and political consulting shops.

name: Media Representative Firms
boundary: Not `programmatic-ad-platforms` or `performance-marketing-agencies`: covers sell-side firms that sell ad inventory for stations, publishers and networks on commission; agencies buy for advertisers.

name: Outdoor Advertising Companies
boundary: Not `retail-media-networks` or `programmatic-ad-platforms`: covers billboard, transit and street-furniture owners who lease sites, hold zoning permits and sell physical faces by the period; their assets are land leases and structures.

name: Direct Mail Agencies
boundary: Not `printing-shops` or `email-sms-marketing-platforms`: covers firms that sell targeted mail and door-to-door campaigns (list selection, postal presort, drop timing, response tracking) whether or not they print the pieces.

name: Portrait Photography Studios
boundary: Not `video-production-smb` or `commercial-photographers`: covers studios selling portraits, weddings, school and sports pictures to consumers, where session booking, proofing, print sales and picture-day logistics are the work.

name: Commercial Photographers
boundary: Not `portrait-photography-studios` or `stock-media-marketplaces`: covers photographers hired by businesses for product, ecommerce, architectural and advertising images with usage licensing; marketplaces resell images, these shoot to brief.

name: Title & Settlement Offices
boundary: Not `mortgage-brokers` or `real-estate-appraisers`: covers title agents and escrow offices that search title, clear defects, issue policies as underwriters' agents and run closings; the underwriters are `title-insurance-carriers`.

name: Notary & Signing Services
boundary: Not `title-and-settlement-offices` or `esignature-document-workflow`: covers notary offices, mobile notaries and loan signing agents paid per signing, whose work is identity proofing and journal compliance under state notary law, not title work or software.

name: Legal Support Services
boundary: Not `small-law-firms`: covers process servers, freelance paralegal services and patent search firms that do legal work without practising law; transcripts belong to `court-reporting-firms`.

name: Film Distributors
boundary: Not `streaming-video-platforms` or `video-production-smb`: covers firms that acquire film rights and license them by territory and window to theaters, TV and platforms; they neither make films nor stream them.

name: Movie Theaters
boundary: Not `event-venues` or `film-distributors`: covers cinema exhibitors who book films on sliding-scale film rent and earn their margin on concessions and premium formats.

name: Postproduction Studios
boundary: Not `video-production-smb`: covers editing, color, VFX, sound-mix and finishing houses hired after the shoot, paid per project and judged on delivery specs (Netflix, DCP, broadcast QC).

name: Music Publishers
boundary: Not `music-distribution-platforms`: covers publishers who own or administer song copyrights (compositions) and collect mechanical, performance and sync royalties; distributors deliver sound recordings.

name: Recording Studios
boundary: Not `podcasting-networks` or `music-distribution-platforms`: covers studios and engineers who record, mix and master for clients by the hour or project.

name: Directory & List Publishers
boundary: Not `data-marketplace-brokers` or `direct-mail-agencies`: covers compilers who build and maintain business directories and mailing lists and sell them by count or subscription; brokers trade other people's datasets.

name: Greeting Card Publishers
boundary: Not `independent-publishers` or `print-on-demand-platforms`: covers card and social-stationery publishers who license art, run seasonal design calendars and sell to retailers on planogram and sell-through terms.

name: Broadcast TV & Radio Stations
boundary: Not `news-media-local` or `streaming-video-platforms`: covers FCC-licensed over-the-air stations that sell local spot inventory against Nielsen ratings and, for TV, collect retransmission fees.

name: Wired Broadband Providers
boundary: Not `utility-contractors`: covers cable, fiber and telco operators (rural ISPs and co-ops included) that own last-mile networks and bill subscribers; contractors build the plant. Mobile networks belong to `wireless-carriers`.

name: Wireless Carriers
boundary: Not `wired-broadband-providers`: covers mobile network operators and fixed-wireless ISPs that hold spectrum licences and run tower-based radio networks, a different engineering and FCC regime.

name: Telecom Resellers
boundary: Not `wireless-carriers` or `it-managed-services`: covers MVNOs, VoIP and UCaaS providers and resellers that buy wholesale capacity and resell it under their own brand.

name: Wireless Retail Agents
boundary: Not `independent-retailers`: covers authorised carrier dealers who earn activation commissions and live with chargebacks and carrier scorecards; their margin is set by the carrier's comp plan, not by merchandise.

name: Satellite Operators
boundary: Not `wired-broadband-providers`: covers firms that own or lease satellite capacity to deliver connectivity, broadcast and earth-observation links, including ground-station operators.

name: Libraries & Archives
boundary: Not `municipal-services` or `k12-private-schools`: covers public, academic and special libraries and archives whose work is collection development, cataloguing, circulation, licensing of e-resources and patron services.

name: Community Banks
boundary: Not `credit-unions` or `neobanks`: covers FDIC-insured commercial banks and thrifts, mostly under $10B in assets, chartered by the OCC or states and owned by shareholders rather than members.

name: Credit Card Issuers
boundary: Not `community-banks` or `bnpl-providers`: covers issuers whose business is revolving credit, with underwriting, line management, rewards economics, fraud and disputes under Reg Z.

name: Sales Finance Companies
boundary: Not `lending-marketplaces` or `bnpl-providers`: covers captive and independent finance companies that buy retail installment contracts from auto, equipment and powersports dealers through indirect dealer funding.

name: Mortgage Lenders
boundary: Not `mortgage-brokers`: covers lenders that fund loans on warehouse lines, underwrite to agency guidelines, and sell or service the loans; brokers originate for them.

name: Pawnshops
boundary: Not `lending-marketplaces` or `thrift-and-resale-stores`: covers licensed pawnbrokers who lend against collateral they value at the counter and resell forfeits, under state pawn laws and police hold-and-report rules.

name: Money Service Businesses
boundary: Not `payment-processors` or `neobanks`: covers check cashers, money transmitters and remittance agents registered with FinCEN as MSBs and licensed state by state.

name: Commodity Brokers
boundary: Not `crypto-exchanges` or `hedge-funds`: covers futures commission merchants and introducing brokers that execute and clear futures for hedgers and speculators under CFTC and NFA rules, grain and livestock hedging desks included.

name: Trust Companies
boundary: Not `wealth-management-rias` or `estate-planning`: covers chartered trust companies and custody banks that act as trustee or custodian, carrying fiduciary duty for trust accounting and discretionary distributions.

name: Pension Funds
boundary: Not `asset-managers`: covers public and corporate pension plans' own staffs (investment office plus benefits administration), the asset owners that hire managers and pay retirees.

name: Self-Insured Benefit & Risk Pools
boundary: Not `insurance-tpa`: covers the trustee-run funds that bear the risk and hire TPAs; not `health-insurance-carriers`, which sell insurance to others.

name: Life Insurance Carriers
boundary: Not `independent-insurance-agents` or `insurtech-platforms`: covers carriers that underwrite life and annuity risk, price mortality, hold statutory reserves and administer policies over decades.

name: Health Insurance Carriers
boundary: Not `insurance-tpa`: covers risk-bearing health plans (commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care) that price premiums, build networks and adjudicate claims on their own paper.

name: Property & Casualty Insurers
boundary: Not `independent-insurance-agents`, `public-adjusters` or `insurtech-platforms`: covers carriers that file rates, underwrite, and pay property and liability claims on their own balance sheet.

name: Title Insurance Carriers
boundary: Not `title-and-settlement-offices`: covers the underwriters (First American, Fidelity National, Old Republic, Stewart and regionals) that hold reserves, set agent rules and pay title claims.

name: Reinsurers
boundary: Not `property-casualty-insurers`: covers carriers that insure insurers through treaty and facultative contracts priced on catastrophe models and cedents' portfolio data.

name: Facilities Management Firms
boundary: Not `cleaning-companies`, `security-guard-firms` or `property-management`: covers integrated facility-services contractors that run buildings, campuses and bases under multi-service outsourcing contracts with SLAs.

name: Executive Search Firms
boundary: Not `staffing-agencies` or `recruiting-tech-vendors`: covers retained search firms paid about a third of first-year compensation to fill senior roles, where research, assessment and confidentiality are the work.

name: Professional Employer Organizations
boundary: Not `payroll-platforms` or `hr-consultants`: covers PEOs that co-employ client workers and carry benefits, workers' comp and payroll-tax liability under IRS CPEO certification and state licensing.

name: Document Preparation Services
boundary: Not `legal-support-services` or `virtual-assistant-services`: covers transcription, typing, resume-writing and document-formatting shops paid per page, per audio minute or per document.

name: Telephone Answering Services
boundary: Not `digital-bpo-operations` or `virtual-assistant-services`: covers live answering services for medical practices, trades and property managers, where on-call escalation scripts and HIPAA handling are the work.

name: Private Mail Centers
boundary: Not `printing-shops`: covers pack-and-ship stores (UPS Store and PostNet franchisees, independents) whose mailbox rental is a USPS Commercial Mail Receiving Agency business with Form 1583 compliance and multi-carrier shipping.

name: Credit Bureaus
boundary: Not `financial-data-vendors` or `identity-verification-vendors`: covers consumer and commercial credit reporting agencies under FCRA, specialty CRAs and tenant- and employment-screening bureaus included.

name: Repossession Agencies
boundary: Not `collections-agencies` or `towing-companies`: covers licensed recovery agents who locate and recover collateral for lenders using LPR camera networks, condition reports and state repossession law.

name: Court Reporting Firms
boundary: Not `legal-support-services` or `document-preparation-services`: covers certified stenographers and firms that capture depositions and hearings and sell certified transcripts under state CSR licensing.

name: Travel Agencies
boundary: Not `hotels-boutique` or `tour-operators`: covers advisors and host-agency networks that earn commission on supplier bookings without owning the inventory.

name: Tour Operators
boundary: Not `travel-agencies` or `event-planning`: covers companies that package and run tours, carrying inventory risk on hotels, guides and transport.

name: Convention & Visitors Bureaus
boundary: Not `event-planning` or `trade-associations`: covers destination marketing organisations funded by hotel occupancy tax to sell a destination to meeting planners and leisure travellers.

name: Ticketing & Reservation Agencies
boundary: Not `event-planning` or `travel-agencies`: covers ticket offices, primary ticketing services, resellers and reservation services that sell seats and rooms on behalf of venues and suppliers.

name: Investigation & Background Screening Firms
boundary: Not `identity-verification-vendors` or `talent-assessment-platforms`: covers licensed private investigators and FCRA background-screening firms that compile records and field evidence for employers, insurers and lawyers.

name: Armored Car Services
boundary: Not `security-guard-firms`: covers cash-in-transit carriers running armored routes, cash vaults and ATM servicing for banks and retailers.

name: Security Alarm Integrators
boundary: Not `electrical-contractors` or `security-guard-firms`: covers alarm dealers, monitoring centers and commercial integrators that install intrusion, access-control and video systems and earn recurring monitoring revenue.

name: Locksmiths
boundary: Not `security-alarm-integrators`: covers mobile and storefront locksmiths whose work is lockouts, rekeying, master-key systems and safe work, licensed in some states.

name: Contract Packagers
boundary: Not `contract-manufacturing` or `warehouse-3pl`: covers co-packers that package and label others' finished products (kitting, displays, blister, shrink, relabelling) to the brand owner's specs without making the product.

name: Auctioneers
boundary: Not `online-marketplaces` or `estate-planning`: covers independent auction firms selling estates, equipment, real estate and consignments on commission, where lot cataloguing and valuation are the craft.

name: Waste Haulers
boundary: Not `municipal-services`: covers private haulers running commercial, residential and roll-off routes under municipal franchise or subscription.

name: Hazardous Waste Firms
boundary: Not `environmental-consultants` or `waste-haulers`: covers RCRA transporters and treatment, storage and disposal facilities (TSDFs).

name: Landfill Operators
boundary: Not `waste-haulers` or `municipal-services`: covers permitted landfill owners and operators selling airspace by the ton, managing leachate, landfill gas and closure liabilities.

name: Waste-to-Energy Plants
boundary: Not `landfill-operators`: covers municipal solid waste combustors that earn both tipping fees and power sales and run under Clean Air Act MACT limits.

name: Materials Recovery Facilities
boundary: Not `waste-haulers` or `scrap-metal-recyclers`: covers MRFs that sort single- and dual-stream recyclables into bales sold to mills on commodity indexes.

name: Septic & Vacuum Service Companies
boundary: Not `plumbing-contractors`: covers pumpers who empty, inspect and maintain septic systems, grease traps and portable toilets.

name: Community Colleges
boundary: Not `vocational-schools`: covers public two-year colleges with open admission, transfer and workforce programs funded by state FTE formulas and Pell.

name: Colleges & Universities
boundary: Not `community-colleges` or `online-course-platforms`: covers four-year and graduate institutions where enrollment, financial aid, research administration and accreditation run the business.

name: IT Training & Coding Bootcamps
boundary: Not `vocational-schools`, `corporate-training` or `online-course-platforms`: covers coding bootcamps and IT certification training centers that sell job outcomes, often unaccredited and financed through ISAs or employer pay.

name: Flight Schools
boundary: Not `vocational-schools`: covers Part 61 and Part 141 flight schools whose aircraft fleet, instructor pool and FAA checkride pass rates are the business.

name: Fine Arts Schools
boundary: Not `tutoring-centers` or `youth-sports-orgs`: covers music, dance, art and drama schools selling recurring lessons, recitals and exam preparation.

name: Sports Instruction Schools
boundary: Not `gyms-independent`, `personal-trainers` or `youth-sports-orgs`: covers martial arts, swim, gymnastics and golf schools that sell curriculum-based progression (belts, levels) on monthly tuition.

name: Driving Schools
boundary: Not `vocational-schools`: covers driver-education and CDL schools under state DMV licensing and the FMCSA entry-level driver training rule.

name: Safety & Certification Training Providers
boundary: Not `corporate-training` or `vocational-schools`: covers CPR and first-aid, OSHA outreach, food-handler and HAZWOPER trainers whose product is a dated certification card with a renewal clock.

name: Education Consulting & Testing Services
boundary: Not `tutoring-centers` or `k12-private-schools`: covers admissions consultants, test developers and scoring services, and study-abroad and school-improvement consultancies.

name: Physician Practices
boundary: Not `urgent-care`, `behavioral-health-clinics` or `healthcare-practice-software`: covers primary-care and specialty physician offices billing E/M visits and procedures.

name: Optometry Practices
boundary: Not `medical-supply-retail` or `optical-retailers`: covers OD practices doing eye exams and medical eye care, with optical dispensing on the side, under vision-plan contracts.

name: Podiatry Practices
boundary: Not `physician-practices` or `physical-therapy`: covers DPM offices (diabetic foot care, orthotics, wound and nail care) under podiatric licensure and Medicare routine-foot-care rules.

name: Community Health Centers
boundary: Not `physician-practices` or `nonprofits-social-services`: covers FQHCs, look-alikes and other outpatient centers that report UDS to HRSA and bill PPS rates.

name: Dialysis Centers
boundary: Not `home-health-agencies` or `community-health-centers`: covers in-center and home dialysis providers paid under the ESRD PPS and CMS conditions for coverage.

name: Clinical Laboratories
boundary: Not `testing-laboratories`: covers CLIA-certified labs that test human specimens and bill payers, from reference labs to physician-office and hospital outreach labs.

name: Diagnostic Imaging Centers
boundary: Not `urgent-care` or `physician-practices`: covers freestanding imaging centers (MRI, CT, X-ray, mammography) where radiologist reads, prior authorisation and scanner utilisation run the business.

name: Ambulance Services
boundary: Not `non-emergency-medical-transport`: covers 911 and interfacility ambulance services (BLS, ALS, air) billed under the Medicare ambulance fee schedule.

name: Blood & Organ Banks
boundary: Not `clinical-laboratories`: covers blood centers, plasma centers and organ procurement organisations whose donor recruitment, testing and FDA/AABB compliance are the work.

name: Health Screening Services
boundary: Not `urgent-care` or `physician-practices`: covers mobile and employer screening services (biometric screening, hearing and vision, sleep testing, health fairs) that test populations rather than treat patients.

name: General Hospitals
boundary: Not `urgent-care` or `physician-practices`: covers acute-care hospitals with inpatient beds, emergency departments and surgery, paid by DRGs and commercial contracts.

name: Psychiatric Hospitals
boundary: Not `behavioral-health-clinics` or `residential-treatment-centers`: covers inpatient psychiatric and substance-use hospitals paid under the IPF PPS, with involuntary-hold law and 24-hour nursing.

name: Specialty Hospitals
boundary: Not `general-hospitals`: covers inpatient rehab, long-term acute care, children's, cancer and orthopedic hospitals with their own CMS payment systems (IRF-PAI, LTCH PPS).

name: Skilled Nursing Facilities
boundary: Not `home-health-agencies` or `assisted-living-communities`: covers SNFs paid under PDPM, run on MDS assessments and rated by CMS Five-Star.

name: Assisted Living Communities
boundary: Not `skilled-nursing-facilities` or `home-health-agencies`: covers state-licensed assisted living and memory care, mostly private pay.

name: IDD Group Homes
boundary: Not `nonprofits-social-services` or `home-health-agencies`: covers ICF/IID facilities and Medicaid HCBS-waiver group homes for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities, staffed by direct support professionals.

name: Residential Treatment Centers
boundary: Not `behavioral-health-clinics` or `psychiatric-hospitals`: covers residential substance-use and mental-health programs billing ASAM levels of care to insurers and Medicaid.

name: Youth Group Homes
boundary: Not `nonprofits-social-services` or `idd-group-homes`: covers child-welfare-funded group homes, residential care and halfway houses paid per diem by state agencies.

name: Self-Storage Operators
boundary: Not `commercial-real-estate` or `property-management`: covers self-storage owner-operators and third-party managers whose street-rate management, existing-customer rent increases, lien auctions and unmanned access are the business.

name: Car Rental Companies
boundary: Not `rideshare-fleet-operators` or `fleet-managers`: covers daily-rental fleets (airport, neighbourhood, insurance replacement) run on utilisation, damage recovery and remarketing.

name: Truck, Trailer & RV Lessors
boundary: Not `car-rental-companies` or `fleet-managers`: covers commercial truck full-service leasing, one-way moving-truck rental and RV rental, with DOT maintenance obligations on the lessor.

name: Rent-to-Own Stores
boundary: Not `bnpl-providers` or `independent-retailers`: covers rent-to-own stores and lease-to-own providers under state RTO laws, where weekly collections and merchandise recovery are the work.

name: Formal Wear & Costume Rental Shops
boundary: Not `alterations-tailoring`: covers tux, gown and costume rental shops whose fitting, alteration and turnaround logistics around event dates are the work.

name: Recreational Equipment Rental Shops
boundary: Not `equipment-rental-companies`: covers bike, kayak, ski, paddleboard and beach rental outfits with seasonal, weather-driven demand and waiver-based liability.

name: Equipment Rental Companies
boundary: Not `construction-tech-platforms` or `fleet-managers`: covers branch-based renters of construction, industrial and general equipment whose time-utilisation and dollar-utilisation are the business.

name: Aircraft & Railcar Lessors
boundary: Not `equipment-rental-companies` or `asset-managers`: covers operating lessors of aircraft, engines, railcars and vessels whose residual values, maintenance reserves and redeliveries are the business.

name: Franchisors
boundary: Not `independent-restaurants` or `hair-salons-independent`, which hold franchisees: covers franchisor head offices that sell and support franchises, collect royalties and keep FDDs current under the FTC Franchise Rule.

name: Performing Arts Companies
boundary: Not `event-planning` or `musical-groups`: covers theater, dance and other performing companies that produce their own seasons, funded by tickets, subscriptions and contributed income.

name: Musical Groups & Orchestras
boundary: Not `creator-businesses` or `music-distribution-platforms`: covers orchestras, bands and ensembles that earn from performances and touring, where booking, union scale and player scheduling are the work.

name: Sports Teams & Clubs
boundary: Not `youth-sports-orgs` or `esports-organizations`: covers professional and minor-league teams earning from tickets, sponsorship and media rights.

name: Racetracks
boundary: Not `casinos` or `event-venues`: covers horse and motorsport tracks earning from pari-mutuel handle, purses and race-day events under state racing commissions.

name: Racing Stables
boundary: Not `racetracks` or `horse-breeding-farms`: covers racing stables and trainers who condition horses and enter races, living on purses and day rates.

name: Event Venues
boundary: Not `event-planning` or `hotels-boutique`: covers arenas, stadiums, amphitheaters and theaters that own facilities and book or co-promote events.

name: Event Promoters
boundary: Not `event-planning` or `creator-talent-agencies`: covers concert promoters and festival producers who take the ticket-sales risk on talent guarantees.

name: Museums
boundary: Not `nonprofits-social-services`: covers art, history and science museums and historic sites whose collections, exhibitions, admissions and membership are the work.

name: Zoos & Botanical Gardens
boundary: Not `museums`: covers zoos, aquariums, botanical gardens and nature parks whose living collections need daily husbandry or horticulture under AZA and USDA rules.

name: Theme Parks
boundary: Not `family-entertainment-centers`: covers ride-based amusement and water parks with ride-safety inspections, seasonal staffing and attendance-driven yield pricing.

name: Family Entertainment Centers
boundary: Not `gyms-independent` or `theme-parks`: covers arcades, bowling centers and indoor attractions that sell games, parties and group events.

name: Casinos
boundary: Not `hotels-boutique` or `gambling-operators`: covers land-based casinos and casino resorts licensed by state or tribal gaming commissions.

name: Sportsbooks & Other Gambling Operators
boundary: Not `casinos`: covers online and retail sportsbooks, bingo halls, off-track betting and slot-route operators, where odds-setting and responsible-gaming compliance are the work.

name: Golf Courses & Country Clubs
boundary: Not `gyms-independent`: covers golf courses and member clubs run on tee sheets, dues, F&B minimums and turf agronomy.

name: Ski Resorts
boundary: Not `theme-parks`: covers ski areas whose snowmaking, lift operations and season-pass economics turn on weather.

name: Marinas
boundary: Not `powersports-and-boat-dealers` or `self-storage-operators`: covers marinas and dry-stack storage selling slips, fuel and boat service.

name: Auto Glass Shops
boundary: Not `auto-body-shops`: covers windshield replacement and repair shops, mostly mobile, billed to insurers through glass networks and now recalibrating ADAS cameras after each install.

name: Quick Lube Shops
boundary: Not `auto-repair-shops`: covers fast oil-change shops whose ten-minute bays, upsell menus and car-count economics differ from diagnostic repair.

name: Car Washes
boundary: Not `auto-body-shops`: covers express tunnel, in-bay automatic and full-service washes, increasingly run on unlimited-wash memberships.

name: Electronics Repair Shops
boundary: Not `it-managed-services`: covers phone, computer and precision-equipment repair shops paid per repair, with parts sourcing and right-to-repair constraints.

name: Industrial Machinery Repair Shops
boundary: Not `metal-fabrication` or `field-service-software`: covers motor-rewind, pump, gearbox, hydraulic and machinery repair shops that fix plant equipment, much of it on emergency turnaround.

name: Appliance Repair Companies
boundary: Not `hvac-contractors`: covers in-home appliance technicians paid per call by homeowners and by warranty companies on fixed authorisations.

name: Upholstery Shops
boundary: Not `alterations-tailoring` or `cleaning-companies`: covers furniture, auto, marine and commercial reupholstery and furniture repair shops quoting by yardage and labour.

name: Shoe Repair Shops
boundary: Not `alterations-tailoring`: covers cobblers and leather-goods repair shops whose resoling, stitching and finishing are a separate craft.

name: Nail Salons
boundary: Not `hair-salons-independent` or `med-spas`: covers nail salons, mostly owner-operated, with walk-in flow, product chemistry exposure and state cosmetology-board rules.

name: Weight Loss Centers
boundary: Not `med-spas` or `gyms-independent`: covers diet and weight-management centers, now split between coaching programs and GLP-1 prescribing clinics.

name: Cemeteries & Crematories
boundary: Not `funeral-homes`: covers cemeteries and crematories selling plots, niches and pre-need contracts and maintaining grounds under perpetual-care trust rules.

name: Laundromats
boundary: Not `drycleaners`: covers coin and card-operated laundries, many adding wash-and-fold and pickup-and-delivery.

name: Drycleaners
boundary: Not `laundromats` or `alterations-tailoring`: covers drycleaning and laundry plants and drop stores, with solvent regulation and spotting as a craft.

name: Commercial Laundries
boundary: Not `cleaning-companies` or `laundromats`: covers linen and uniform rental services that own the textiles, launder them in industrial plants and deliver on routes.

name: Photo Labs
boundary: Not `printing-shops` or `portrait-photography-studios`: covers film-processing and photo-printing labs, from pro labs to the film-revival mail-in labs.

name: Parking Operators
boundary: Not `property-management` or `commercial-real-estate`: covers operators who run lots and garages under management or lease contracts, with yield pricing, enforcement and revenue control.

name: Bail Bond Agencies
boundary: Not `collections-agencies` or `public-defenders`: covers licensed bail agents who post surety bonds for defendants, take collateral and recover skips.

name: Grantmaking Foundations
boundary: Not `grant-writers` or `nonprofits-social-services`: covers private, family and community foundations that make grants rather than deliver services.

name: Advocacy Nonprofits
boundary: Not `nonprofits-social-services` or `trade-associations`: covers cause organisations that fundraise from individuals and run campaigns rather than deliver services or represent an industry.

name: Civic & Fraternal Clubs
boundary: Not `trade-associations` or `faith-organizations`: covers service clubs, fraternal lodges, alumni and social clubs that live on dues, volunteers and events.

name: Labor Unions
boundary: Not `trade-associations` or `hr-consultants`: covers unions and locals that organise, bargain contracts, process grievances and run hiring halls and benefit funds.

name: Political Campaigns & Committees
boundary: Not `advocacy-nonprofits` or `marketing-agencies-smb`: covers candidate campaigns, parties and PACs, which raise under FEC or state limits and spend against an election date.

name: Bed-and-Breakfasts
